insight: For venue→work→subtitle questions, route to direct_mas with planner enabled and at least 4 retrievals; avoid sas_first-only, which mislinks entities and misses subtitles.
applies_when: User asks a work attribute via a venue or production mention.
avoid_when: Single-hop facts or pure entity disambiguation.

insight: Plan two hops: (1) identify the exact production/work from the venue cue; (2) fetch the work’s official subtitle; include attribute-type check to avoid returning the title.

avoid_when: Request is for the title itself or non-work logistics.

insight: After confirming the work, run a targeted lookup: 'subtitle of [work title] by [composer]'; verify venue context and roles before extracting the exact subtitle string.
applies_when: Work title and composer are resolved or confidently inferred.
avoid_when: Work remains ambiguous; only venue known—resolve identity first.

avoid_when: Non-temporal queries or title is explicit with uncontested date.

avoid_when: Title needs disambiguation or requires broader historical context.

insight: Issue one query: "[Film title] release year" and extract the year; ignore unrelated attribute trails.
applies_when: Search includes exact film title and the goal is the release year.
avoid_when: Results are attribute digressions or multi-hop exploration is required.

avoid_when: Non-person targets, living persons without a death date, or when the prompt explicitly requests a stage name.

avoid_when: Film title is explicit or the query is purely temporal/attribute-focused.

insight: Route alias+founding-year bridges to direct_mas with mandatory verification and 2–3 retrievals; avoid sas_first.
